stem_book: Find the elongation or compression in the spring at equilibrium of the block(s) in the following case: a light string passes over a fixed smooth pulley; block A (m₁ = 10 kg) hangs from one end, and block B (m₂ = 10 kg) hangs from the other end through a light spring of k = 500 N/m inserted in the string. (g = 10 m/s²)
work: Equal masses → at rest, T = mg = 100 N → x = T/k = 100/500 = 0.2 m
